newsitem.title: INDIA: Dunlop India managing director resigns.
newsitem.headline: Dunlop India managing director resigns.

text.p: Dunlop India Ltd said on Monday that managing director M.D. Shukla had resigned and the company's board of directors had accepted the resignation.

The company said in a statement that the board had appointed P.J. Rao, executive director of Shaw Wallace & Co Ltd and T.S. Shettigar, finance director of Jumbo International Holdings Ltd, as additional directors.
"As an interim measure, a committee of three directors including P.J. Rao has been set up," the statement said, without naming the other members of the committee.
The committee will initiate steps to strengthen the management team and the executive board, it added.
"The board has also decided with a view to bringing in further transparency in Dunlop to have an audit done of Dunlop's management and financial performance," the statement said.
The company said that all its factories and offices were running normally.
Dunlop India, a Calcutta-based company, is one of the nation's leading tyre makers.
